## Lurker Above (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
 N Huge aberration  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +12  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 9, flat-footed 18 (+1 Dex, +10 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 95 (10d8+40)  
 **Fort** +7, **Ref** +4, **Will** +9  
 **Defensive Abilities** amorphous; **DR** 10/slashing or piercing; **Resist** cold 10, fire 10  
 **Weaknesses** light sensitivity  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 10 ft., climb 5 ft., fly 40 ft. (poor)  
 **Melee** slam +15 (3d8+15 plus grab)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** constrict (3d6+15), smother  

**Tactics**

 A lurker above waits for its prey, clinging to the ceiling, roof, or other such overhang. When prey passes beneath it, the lurker above drops from its hiding place and wraps itself around its prey.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 30, **Dex** 12, **Con** 19, **Int** 2, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 9  
 **Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +19 (+23 grapple); **CMD** 31 (can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth)  
 **Skills** Climb +23, Fly +1, Perception +12, Stealth +8 (+16 in rocky areas); **Racial Modifiers** +4 Stealth (+12 in rocky areas)  

**Special Abilities**

 **Smother (Ex)** When a lurker above grapples a target, it forms an airtight seal around its prey. A grappled target cannot speak or cast spells with verbal components and must hold its breath.  
  
  
  

**Ecology**

**Environment** underground  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** standard
